# FG-AUTH-0030

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `org_binding_unit_not_in_master_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 指定した組織が組織の台帳にありません。一覧から組織を選んでください。
- en: The organisation unit is not in the organisation master. Pick the unit from the list.
- id: Unit organisasi tidak ada di master organisasi. Pilih unit dari daftar.

## 原因 (cause)

A binding was asked for a (plant, unit) that the copy of the PFS organisation master (`forge.org_units_master`, ADR-0038 §1) does not hold: a typo, a unit that was closed in PFS, a version that starts later (`valid_from` in the future), or the copy was never synced. Bindings are kept to units the master knows, so that the hierarchy (descendants) can be read. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`: `not_in_master` (with `plant_code`, `org_code`), `not_yet_valid`, or `master_missing` (no sync ever succeeded: `forge doctor` row `org.master`, FG-INT-0028 / FG-INT-0025..0027). Read-only: `SELECT code, level, valid_from FROM forge.org_units_master WHERE plant_code = '<plant>' AND code = '<code>'`.

## 対処 (fix)

Pick a unit from the list (`GET /api/v1/org-units`, the settings screen's picker). If the unit should exist, check the org master sync (runbook oidc-login, 「組織の台帳の写し」) and the unit in PFS.
